notes.title: Cat N Can will release on 1/12!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43096881/a0811b8e4fd808f8b0ffaa7b7b9473bb9be9a71c.png[/img]

Hi everyone;
Cat N Can is coming on 1/12 8:00 AM EST. it would have 100 level. Come and play with cat, help the cat eat his favorite cans!!

There’s one factor that’s really important to a game on Steam: wishlists. That’s why we’ve been revealing so many games in advance. We need to have as many wishlists as we possibly can by the day of each game launch, otherwise said game will be completely lost amidst all the other current releases.

So, we politely ask you: if you’re interested in our games, remember to add them to your wishlist and follow them, so we can stand a chance among the others. ♥
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43096881/da8b1ca645f41cd6e8db23975ee738b39ef09715.gif[/img]

Even if you don’t wish to buy the game right at its release, having considerable wishlists and followers helps us to gain some projection inside Steam’s algorithm. It is very helps!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43096881/90411c703b37851fe47f1b3cb82ace7cf93e7bdc.gif[/img]
[b][h2]Feature[/h2][/b]:
🐈[b]easy control[/b]:
🐈🐈you only need using your mouse can control everything

🐈[b]tons of reactable object[/b]:
🐈🐈all the object on map a reactable, it make the level more harder and more fun, also you can see the cat cute reaction

🐈[b]burn your mind[/b]:
🐈🐈this puzzle game is very hard, you can feel satisfy when you solve it.
